summary: User remarks authorize the next local product continuation; full scope and acceptance sequence retained in docs/mvp/REMARKS_HANDOFF.md.
details:
User-authored root remarks, attributed to the user and not independent market/physical-use evidence:
- setting start and finish by clicking on map doesn't appear as pin.
- Can't select adress instead of lat, long point (say I want to go home, I'd rather type the adress)
- If I want to to go via points, it would make more sense to add them in a sort of timeline between start and finish (add a point, then click on map or write adress).
- Via points could be selected to be approximate, and you could then set radius where as long as you pass through this radius you are fine
- Instead of A -> B and loop ride, should have only one menu and you can select to set finish same as start or vice versa.
- Would be nice to have a colored map (green for greenery, blue for water etc.)
- It would be nice to have landmarks and nice viewpoints to suggest breaks not too far from the actual break time in a nice location
- "Local routing engine unavailable. Start it, then retry." If it doesn't exist, make it exist. A guess of how it should work is for now just fastest path, but suggestions will in essence add a bunch of waypoints to force the track to go through the wanted path. User could then edit a suggestion and move, remove or add waypoints.
- It would be nice to train a classifier from road images (say from google maps street view if available) for meta labels, and a score (either continuous or category) of how nice it would be to go through. Maybe collect a dataset, split into training, evaluation and test for now. And suggest what / how we should train. multilabel classifier ? Or something like forest: number between 0 and 1, water [0,1], industrial: [0,1], populated [0,1] ... so that you can tune very specific parameters in your search.
- User editing a path is good training data so we know what he expected.
- Should probably have some way to saying in natural language what your preferences are, which directions it should go to and an agent translates that into actual atomic criterias for finding the path. No need to have an agent for now, but backbone / routes could already be implemented.

Coordinator handoff uses Foundry2026-10-08.1. Only the first task is ready; continue sequentially after acceptance, retaining historical human gates.
